reuse.why: Keeps using getApproxNumberThreshold, but edits the inline expression in computeSchedulePreviewTransactions instead of extracting a shared worst-case helper that the identical expectedAmount expression in api-models.ts could also call.

duplication.why: The worst-case expression already exists twice (shared/schedules.ts preview and server/api-models.ts expectedAmount); the diff changes one copy only, leaving the two silently divergent rather than consolidating them.

placement.why: The edit is in shared/schedules.ts where the preview amount is computed, which is a reasonable home for the rule.

scope.why: Small, focused change to the expression plus matching test updates.

maintainability.why: The rule remains an inline nested ternary duplicated in api-models.ts, which now applies the old furthest-from-zero rule, so future changes must remember both copies.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No worst-case helper existed to bypass; getApproxNumberThreshold is still used.

disguised_duplication.where: The diff adds no new copy; it leaves the pre-existing api-models.ts expectedAmount copy untouched (and now inconsistent).
